{"code": "from werkzeug.routing import Map, Rule

# Define the URL rules
url_map = Map([
    Rule('/', endpoint='index'),
    Rule('/downloads/', endpoint='downloads/index'),
    Rule('/downloads/<int:id>', endpoint='downloads/show')
])

# Bind the URL map to the server name and path
adapter = url_map.bind('example.com', script_name='')

# Match the specified URL and HTTP method
match_result = adapter.match('/downloads/123', method='GET')

# Return the result as a JSON list
match_result"}
